release_groups.scope: single owner and fenced UDS-to-TCP only

unknown SoC or vendor EndSOC => no automatic Auto
single physical TCP owner independently verified

FC03 quality / mode before and after
per-register FC06 acknowledgement and independent power

release_groups.scope: target selection only; never bundled with broker migration

independent phase and SoC data fresh
existing site dispatcher backup and custom drop-ins preserved
observable: planned target and actual control outcome

validate current action/readback and reserve guards

release_groups.scope: plan computation and API, no physical change bundled

same SQLite schema and DB backup
no stale live SoC published as current
observable: web HTTP and OAuth2 control boundary

preserve SQLite and old plan snapshots
